title: WEATHER FORECAST FOR 16 March 2026 Issued at 2.00 p.m. on 15 March 2026 Showers or thundershowers will occur at several places in Western, Sabaragamuwa, Central and Uva provinces and in Galle and Matara districts after 2.00 pm. A few showers may occur in Eastern Province in the morning. Misty conditions can be expected at some places in Central, Sabaragamuwa and Uva provinces and in Galle and Matara districts during the early hours of the morning. The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damages caused by temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershowers.
